flavor.text: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

abilities.name: Cud Chew
abilities.description: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

abilities.name: Armor Tail
abilities.description: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
